name: @topcoat-spike/dom-runtime
description: The vendored client runtime for the Rust->JS emitter: solid-js/web's DOM runtime, bundled to a single self-contained ESM file exporting exactly the dom-expressions client ABI.
$note-bundler: esbuild rather than tsup. crates/topcoat-runtime/browser uses tsup, and this
build mirrors its settings exactly (esm / noExternal / platform browser /
target es2022 / minify / sourcemap). But tsup is a wrapper whose value is
TypeScript entry handling and dts emission, and this package has neither: a
single hand-written .js re-export file. esbuild is what tsup would call
anyway, with one less layer between the pin and the artifact.
